script: The tallest volcano in the solar system is on Mars. It is called Olympus Mons, and it is about two and a half times taller than Mount Everest. Its base is roughly as wide as the state of Arizona. Its slopes are so gentle and wide that from the summit, the edges would be hidden beyond the curve of the planet. It probably grew so big because Mars has no moving tectonic plates to carry it away from its hot spot. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
